t.zh: 定义只说了一个方向：晨星有的，昏星都有。反过来也成立，要选一个巧妙的性质。
t.en: The definition says one direction only: what the Morning Star has, the Evening Star has. The other way holds too, with a well-chosen property.

after.zh: 声明相等时，对称要用自反律和等量代换证出来；定义相等时，自反和代换由定义得来，对称也就跟着有了。两种做法给出同样的规则。
after.en: With equality declared, symmetry is proved from reflexivity and substitution; with it defined, reflexivity and substitution come from the definition, and symmetry with them. Both ways give the same rules.

brief.zh: 已知晨星 = 昏星（按定义写出），证明昏星 = 晨星（也按定义写出）。
brief.en: Given the Morning Star = the Evening Star (by the definition), prove the Evening Star = the Morning Star (by the definition too).

hint.zh: 任取框取 Q。框里，从已知选定一例，性质选「Q(x) → Q(晨星)」。
hint.en: A for-any box takes Q. Inside, choose an instance of the given with the property “Q(x) → Q(the Morning Star)”.

hint.zh: 得到「(Q(晨星) → Q(晨星)) → (Q(昏星) → Q(晨星))」：前一半正是<level-ref to="h-eq-refl"></level-ref>证过的样子，用一个假设框给出，再套用。
hint.en: That gives “(Q(the Morning Star) → Q(the Morning Star)) → (Q(the Evening Star) → Q(the Morning Star))”: the first half is what <level-ref to="h-eq-refl"></level-ref> proved; give it with an assumption box, then Apply.
